product.name: CODE4CARE
product.one_liner: CODE4CARE helps community pharmacies in Malaysia identify medicines by barcode and provide customers with clear, reliable medicine information, including uses, dosage instructions, and safety warnings from verified sources.
product.customer: Community pharmacies and independent pharmacy owners in Malaysia.
product.problem: Customers frequently ask us about medicines, their uses, and how to take them. Our staff spend time searching for reliable information, explaining the same details repeatedly, and helping customers understand medicine labels.
product.today: Pharmacy staff manually inspect medicine packaging, read product leaflets, search medicine databases, consult pharmacists, or refer to official medicine information sources.

roles.name: Registered user
roles.what: signs in to scan medicine barcodes, view medicine information, access scan history and save medicines to favourites

roles.name: Pharmacist/health care professional
roles.what: Reviews medicine information, checks dosage instructions and warnings, and helps verify medicine information where authorised.

roles.name: Guest User
roles.what: Can scan and view permitted public information without creating an account.

roles.name: System Administrator
roles.what: Manages system configuration, data sources, integrations and technical operations. Has access only to the administrative functions assigned to this role.

features.name: barcode scanner
features.what: Scan medicine barcodes using a mobile camera or compatible barcode scanner

use_case.goal: To scan a medicine barcode using a camera or supported barcode scanner and automatically retrieve the matching medicine information, including its name, active ingredient, strength, dosage form, uses, administration instructions and warnings when verified information is available.
steps: The user opens CODE4CARE and selects Scan Medicine.
The system requests camera permission if it has not already been granted.
The user grants permission and positions the medicine barcode within the scanning area.
The system detects and decodes the barcode automatically.
The system validates the barcode and searches the medicine database for a matching record.
The system retrieves the available verified medicine information.
The system automatically displays the medicine details page when a reliable match is found.
The user reviews the medicine name, active ingredient, strength, dosage form, uses, administration instructions and warnings.
If no matching record is found, the system displays a message and offers manual barcode entry or medicine search.
errors: Missing or invalid input: a message says what to fix, and nothing is saved.
Signed out, or a role without permission: refused.

top_three.title: Security
targets: Every input is validated on the server
Secrets live only in environment variables, never in code, logs or the browser
HTTPS only, secure cookies and CSRF protection
Rate limits on sign-in and on every public route
A dependency audit runs on every build (pip-audit or npm audit)
Reviewed against the OWASP Top 10 before launch

top_three.title: Reliability
targets: Every error gives a clear message, and nothing is left half-saved
Calls to outside services time out and retry with back-off
Daily backups, restored once to prove they work
Payments and actions are idempotent: a retry never runs them twice

top_three.title: Performance
targets: p95 page load under 2 seconds on a phone over 4G
p95 API response under 500 ms, not counting AI calls
A database index for every list and search

baseline.title: Availability
baseline.baseline: An uptime check with an alert

baseline.title: Scalability
baseline.baseline: No state kept in the app server's memory

baseline.title: Privacy and PDPA
baseline.baseline: A privacy notice, and no personal data in logs

baseline.title: Usability and accessibility
baseline.baseline: Works on a phone; error messages say what to do

baseline.title: Observability
baseline.baseline: One safe log line per request

baseline.title: Cost efficiency
baseline.baseline: Know the monthly bill before it arrives
